newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU confirms 45,000 tns Bangladesh wheat aid award.
newsitem.headline: EU confirms 45,000 tns Bangladesh wheat aid award.

text.p: The European Union on Tuesday confirmed the award of a food aid tender to deliver 45,000 tonnes of common wheat to Bangladesh, including 25,000 tonnes at 155.85 Ecus a tonne and the balance at 159.43 Ecus a tonne.
Korn Og Foderstofkompagniet (KFK), based in Viby, Denmark, will ship 25,000 tonnes at the lower price, according to the EU Official Journal C 67/97.
Glencore Grain, based in Rotterdam, Netherlands, will ship 20,000 tonnes at the higher price.
Delivery dates were not specified but a European Commission official said on Monday the wheat aid was due to be shipped during March.
